$comment: decisionbook-record/1, the published data, as data any language can read: one JSON line of `.decisionbook/<id>.jsonl`. The first line of a file is the `plan` record and carries the schema; every later line is one record of a type below. A changed field needs a major (pinned by contract/). Unknown keys are ignored. contracts/shapes.cjs is its one door; kit's validator reads the shapes.

notes.rels: the web: a relation from a plan, the node type it points at, and its word read from the other end; `derived` ones only a verb writes. caused-by: a bug's origin, the commit that brought it
notes.itemKind: a plan's lenses as one record: actor, primary feature, edge case, cross-feature impact (covers the consumers it keeps), shared consumer, precedent, repro evidence, risk, rollback path, task (covers the checks it delivers), step (one ordered implementation step, read by the Step shape: its order, the planned file it changes with an optional `:line` or `:symbol`, the change in words (a short pseudo-diff allowed), verify: the check id or the command that proves it, after: the order of the step it needs; a later step of the same order replaces it); gap (one gap of the rubric's GAPS list closed, read by the Gap shape: gap, its id; status evidence (source, a file:line here, or run, the command of a run research record), asked (q, the question deciding gap.<id>, which a person's decision answers) or na (text says why); a later gap item of the same id replaces it)
notes.plan: level: the AI's proposal (small fix, normal work, critical work); code decides the level it runs at (core/level)
notes.research: grounding: what was asked (a tool, a query, a command), what it answered, where: before any question to a person. settles: the decision key of a fork the code closed; it then cites file:line of this repository (Cited)
notes.pointer: a tool's answer (an MCP server, a web or documentation tool): what it pointed at, kept beside the research, never counted as research; a research record of such a tool is stored as one
notes.question: decides, the key of the decision it unlocks; whyNotCode, why the code, git or an earlier plan cannot answer it. Both are required when it is written (an older one is read as it is). proposal: the answer the AI proposes, as it shows it to the person with the question; a reply of theirs that takes the proposals whole decides this question as that proposal, only where the AI's message before their reply showed it. to: someone other than the person it is addressed to (a colleague, by name or role), with source: where the question comes from (a file:line, an issue comment, the person's sentence that said to ask them); such a question is parked: it blocks nothing and counts as no fork, every session start names it until it is answered, and its answer is a decision with said (that someone's own words, quoted) and source (where the quote is), stored as theirs, never as the person's
notes.decision: scope: where it holds (null: everywhere); supersedes: `<plan>/<key>` it replaces; proposed: an AI's guess, never binding; files: what it governs; by: a person's entered name, or ai, set by the product; said: the person's own whole sentence that decides it, copied from a message of theirs (in a session a decision is theirs only on it). effect: what it changed in the plan, each `kind:value`: file:<planned path>, check:<id>, or <item kind>:<item text>; required when it answers a question
notes.assumption: what the AI took as given to go on, apart from any answer: it never answers a question (q: the one it stands in for) or counts as a person's
notes.confirm: the person's yes to the plan, in their words; READY needs one given after the last planned path (core/ready); by is never the AI. amended: written by the verb, never by the sender: the kinds of the records that changed the plan between the person's last message and this yes (plans, amend, check, task, step), never their words
notes.link: a link says why or where from
notes.waiver: a lower level than a soft signal asks for, with who approved it
notes.resume: read only, in an older plan: a later session's note that it went on with the READY plan. READY is the freeze, so no session needs one and nothing reads it; one sent is kept as history
notes.aside: the person sets this open plan aside for other work: by is never the AI, said is their yes, their own whole sentence from their next message after the AI's message that named this plan and asked whether it is set aside (set by the product as theirs, else refused); the plan is kept as history and covers nothing
notes.no-fork: an item of kind no-fork: the task leaves no further choice to the person, and why in a sentence; file: the planned path it speaks of (what was read there and why nothing in it is open). It stands for the forks a level asks beyond the ones found only while every question the plan asks has the person's answer, and only once the questions asked reach the level's number or every planned path has such an item of its own; the fill-in never hands one
notes.variants: a record read by another shape than its type's: `type: [field, { value: shape }]`
notes.builtOn: the rule of the one link DecisionBook writes by itself, as data. add writes `built-on <earlier plan>` (why: what was used, one line; source: the read) in the same append as a record of this plan that uses an earlier one this host session read (read: a recall card given, decisionbook show of it or of one of its decisions, decisionbook related) and the person did not unlink. records: the types whose content can come from another plan (a link is one already; the person's confirm and waiver, a resume and an amend are not content). use: names, a value of the record names its id or decision:<key> of an active decision it holds; reuses, a decision of a key it holds active. Reading alone links nothing, a paraphrase links nothing, and a link changes no decision
notes.unlink: the person removes a link DecisionBook wrote (rel: one of unlinks), with why; by is never the AI; a later use never writes it again (written before any link, it keeps that one from being written)
notes.Config: `.decisionbook/config.json`: protect, the globs an AI edit needs a READY plan for; danger, where a planned file makes the work critical and the gate guards it; answer, the person's answer to setup's protect question, with its door and time
